description: What does owner B see of A's unresolved change and then of its rollback, through a dynaset and a snapshot opened earlier and through new snapshots? Owner A = Workspaces(0) with DBEngine.OpenDatabase(main, writable); owner B = DBEngine.CreateWorkspace('second', dbUseJet) with its own OpenDatabase(main, writable); one STA. B opens dynaset rsd and snapshot rss on Wide rows 1, 2 and 64. A: BeginTrans; UPDATE Wide SET V = 100 WHERE ID = 1 (dbFailOnError). B: rsd and rss MoveFirst and read all; new snapshot. A: Rollback; DBEngine.Errors. B: rsd and rss MoveFirst and read all (no requery); new snapshot; Requery on both and read all; new snapshot. Close; read Wide through a fresh Workspace.
retentionNote: Designed r-txn-1b probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
